What's your return and refund policy?
Happy to help. Here is a clear overview of how our returns and refunds work.
Returns window
Full‑price items: return within 30 days of receipt, in original condition, for a refund.
Sale items: register your return within 14 days of receipt, then you have a further 14 days to send it back, in original condition.
Returns are free within the UK.
Our returns policy applies to orders placed directly with us.
How to create a return
Register your return and create your label via our online returns portal ZigZag (opens in a new tab).
Refunds
We refund the amount you paid for the item to your original payment method once it arrives back and is checked.
If you return something from an order that also has an outstanding pre‑order item, the cost of the outstanding item may be deducted from your refund, with the balance returned to your original payment method.
Non‑refundable items
Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed.
Earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
Exchanges
We do not offer exchanges. Please return the item for a refund and place a new order online so you can see live stock and delivery options.
Offers and discounts
Discounts are applied per item. You keep the discount on any items you keep. Returned items are refunded at the price you paid after the discount.
Delivery fees
If an Express parcel arrived late, the delivery fee cannot be refunded.
365‑day quality guarantee
After the standard returns window (or the sale‑item window), you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards up to one year after your order arrived.
Faulty within 6 months: we will refund the item.
Between 6 and 12 months: we will credit your account for the amount paid. Account credit has no expiry and can be used on any future order, including sale items.
If you used a discount or offer, we will adjust the refund or credit accordingly.
You can find the full policy and details here: Returns and refunds (opens in a new tab).
